text: {"candidate":{"version":1,"op":"Reject","reason":"Adapting collab_check to collab_claim requires nested response structures (file_status.safe and file_status.blocked) and array mapping/grouping of conflicts with fields that were dropped (session IDs, scope, started_at), which cannot be expressed with flat ConstructResponse.
